arguments.sql: SELECT c.relname AS table_name, con.conname, pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('schema_tables_registry','schema_columns_registry','schema_table_knowledge_registry') ORDER BY c.relname,con.conname;
